༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor spros bcas ming gi rim pa gsal bar byed pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor spros bcas ming gi rim pa gsal bar byed pa bzhugs so/ /

bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal te/ /dkyil 'khor spros bcas nang zhugs pa'i/ /ming gi rim pa gsal byed pa/ /'di nyid du ni rab bshad bya/ / de'ang thog ma'i 'od gsal rdo rje snying po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin las rang nyid gang gtso ba dang*/ nye ba'i dkyil 'khor gang yin brtag pa'i phyir/ me tog dor ba las/ dbus su babs na/ chos dby-ings ye shes de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnam par snang mdzad las dras te/ gnas lugs mtshon pa'i ming gdags pa ni/ sna tshogs rang grol/ chos dbyings dri med/ lhun grub rgyal po/ 'gyur med ye shes/ mkha' 'gro klong yangs pa/ mi dmigs chos nyid/ ye grol gnyug ma/ lhun mnyam bya bral/ kun byed rgyal po/ klong chen rab 'byams/ mkha' mnyam chos sku/ gzhi bral chos nyid/ bsam rdzogs rgyal po/ brjod med mtshon 'das/ byang chub snying po/ gnyug ma phyam gdal/ ye stong rtsa bral/ kun grol ye shes/ ma lus chos nyid/ rol pa ye shes/ gang shar rang grol/ ye grol 'dzin med/ ma btsal rang rdzogs/ byar med rang byung*/ sangs rgyas rang chas/ mi 'gyur lhun grub/ khyab gdal chen po/ snang srid chos sku/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa la sogs te dbyings 'pho 'gyur med pa la dras nas/ skyes pa dang bud med gang 'os su gdags so/ / shar du babs na me long ye shes rdo rje'i rigs mi bskyod pa las dras te/ 'od gsal mtshon pa'i ming la/ rdo rje snying po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje legs pa/ 'od lnga lhun grub/ ye shes dri med/ ngang dwangs 'od gsal/ lhun mnyam mi g.yo/ phyam gcig byang chub/ gsal stong 'dzin med/ rang gsal chos sku/ ma lus lhun grub/ gdod nas byang chub/ dmigs bsam spros bral/ 'gag med rang gsal/ rang byung ye shes/ 'od gsal snying po/ gnyis med ye shes/ phyogs med rang yan/ dmigs med kun grol/ yangs pa chen po/ 'gro ba chos nyid/ bsam rdzogs gdod ma/ byar med nam mkha'/ ma skyes chos nyid/

mi gnas rang byung*/ me long ye shes/ rol pa 'gags med/ rgya yan rang grol/ mtha' bral dbu ma/ rdzogs pa rang byung*/ rig pa dri med/ rang shar 'gag med/ mtha' grol klong chen la sogs te/ gsal dngas 'od gsal las drangs te gang 'os su gdags so/ / lhor babab na mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen rigs rin 'byung las dras te/ gnyis med mtshon pa'i ming la/ 'dod yon rang shar/ rgya chen dpal 'byor/ yon tan rang byung*/ bsam rdzogs rgyal po/ tshogs can lhun rdzogs/ 'dod dgu rang shar/ yid bzhin snying po/ dpe med rang grol/ don grub snying po/ zhing khams rnam dag /lhun grub ye shes/ ma byas rang rdzogs/ gzhi bde chos nyid/ ye shes rgyas pa/ chos nyid ngag dbang*/ klong rdzogs rgyal po/ rang byung klong rgyas/ rol pa rang shar/ gang shar chos nyid/ cir snang mnyam grol/ blang dor gnyis med/ gtad med yongs grol/ sku gsum rang rdzogs/ ye shes lnga ldan/ gzungs sprin snying po/ ye shes nyi ma/ lhun grub gza' skar la sogs pa ste gnyis su med pa'i ming las brtsam ste gdags so/ / nub tu babs na pad+ma'i rigs 'od dpag med kun rtog ye shes kyi ming la/ bde chen rgyal po/ khams gsum yongs grol/ ma bsam chos nyid/ cir snang ye shes/ lhun mnyam bde chen/ /pad+ma klong chen/ klong gsal dri med/ bde chen rang byung*/ thams cad babs bde/ gzhi med rang gsal/ 'gro ba byang chub/ thams cad chos nyid/ 'khor 'das ye grol/ ma spangs yongs rdzogs/ rang gsal bde chen/ 'od gsal klong rgyas/ byang chub rang byung*/ mkha' mnyam bde chen/ gzhi rtsa byang chub/ rang byung chos nyid/ yod med mtha' bral/ yangs dog gnyis med/ chos skur rang lugs/ mi dmigs phyam gdal la sogs pa ste ye shes rang gsal gyi ming rnams gdags so/ / byang du babs na bya grub ye shes las kyi rigs don yod grub pa las brtsam ste/ sgo lnga bya bral/ lhun rdzogs chos sku/ rang shar ris med/

'dzin med rgyal po/ ma lus yongs grol/ sku mnyam yangs pa/ lhun mnyam yongs grol/ phyam cig sangs rgyas/ ye nas byar med/ bya btsal kun grol/ khyab gdal chos nyid/ phrin las lhun grub/ yongs rdzogs byang chub/ rang gzhan don grub/ ma spangs yongs rdzogs/ rtsol sgrub byar med/ chos sku rang rdzogs/ lhun grub 'dzin med/ yongs grol chen po la sogs te phyogs yan re dogs dang bral ba'i ming rnams gdags so/ / mtshams su babs na phyogs gnyis bsres pa'am/ phyogs de gang yin gdags so/ /ming gi gnad yig gsang ba sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis rang byung pad+ma'i gnas su bkod pa'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)dkyil 'khor spros bcas ming gi rim pa gsal bar byed pa/ - PAGE 92 -- PAGE 93 -- PAGE 91 -
